guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu rose from 0.278 to 18.47 (+6545%, z=+589) and its latency-50/90 rose 289%/411%, while emailservice mem (+13.7%, z=2.7) and socket (+2.9%) barely moved, so the signal is CPU rather than memory or socket. Confidence is only medium because the slowest traces mostly go frontendservice -> currencyservice -> productcatalogservice and do not include emailservice, error spans appear only in frontendservice, there are no warning or error logs, and the other services' latencies are flat or lower.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice CPU usage and throttling, then raise its CPU limit or add replicas. If a runaway process is found, restart the emailservice pod. Also check why the frontendservice -> currencyservice traces are slow (1.5-1.8 s), since that path does not involve emailservice.
